FW_A.name: Superiority Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT)
mandatory_elements: Exact Article Title as root heading
Inline source coordinate anchors for every factual claim (e.g. [Methods, Para 3], [Results, Table 2])
Primary & Secondary endpoints with Hazard Ratios, 95% Confidence Intervals, and p-values
Absolute Risk Reduction (ARR) and Number Needed to Treat (NNT)
Safety profile with Grade 3-5 Adverse Events, drug discontinuation rates, and treatment-related deaths
RoB 2 five-domain evaluation: Randomization, Deviations, Missing Data, Measurement, Reported Results
Evaluation of Proportional Hazards assumption on Kaplan-Meier survival curves
Complete Bibliographic Citation with DOI / PubMed ID
negative_constraints: NO medical disclaimers or legal liability text
NO conversational filler, greetings, or sign-offs
NO therapeutic mandates or clinical recommendations beyond the reported study data
NO uncited baseline balance claims

FW_B.name: Systematic Review & Meta-Analysis
mandatory_elements: PRISMA search databases, date ranges, and study inclusion count
Pooled effect size metrics (Risk Ratio, Odds Ratio, Hazard Ratio) with 95% Confidence Intervals
Quantitative heterogeneity assessment: Higgins I^2 percentage and Cochran Q p-value
Assessment of fixed-effect vs random-effects modeling appropriateness
Publication bias evaluation via funnel plot symmetry and Egger regression test
GRADE Certainty ratings (High, Moderate, Low, Very Low) across critical outcomes with downgrade justifications
Complete Bibliographic Citation
negative_constraints: NO medical disclaimers or filler phrases
NO pooling of statistically heterogeneous studies (I^2 > 50%) under fixed-effect assumptions without critique

FW_C.name: Observational / Real-World Evidence (RWE)
mandatory_elements: Target population, inclusion/exclusion criteria, data source (EHR, claims registry)
Confounding adjustment mechanisms (multivariable regression, Propensity Score matching, IPTW)
Immortal time bias audit (definition of entry vs treatment index dates)
Unmeasured confounding assessment and residual bias critique
Complete Bibliographic Citation
negative_constraints: NO causal assertions (must frame findings strictly as associations)
NO medical disclaimers or conversational dialogue

FW_D.name: Biomarker & Diagnostic Accuracy Study
mandatory_elements: Marker classification: Prognostic (main effect) vs Predictive (treatment interaction term)
Diagnostic accuracy metrics: Sensitivity, Specificity, AUC / ROC, PPV, NPV
Cut-point selection analysis: pre-fixed vs data-derived optimal cut-points
Independent validation cohort assessment (cross-validation alone is insufficient)
Assay technical validation, Limit of Detection (LOD), and pre-analytical specimen handling
Complete Bibliographic Citation
negative_constraints: NO clinical utility claims without independent validation cohort confirmation
NO conflation of prognostic and predictive marker attributes
NO medical disclaimers

FW_E.name: Clinical Trial Protocol & Statistical Analysis Plan
mandatory_elements: Trial design, phase, comparator arm, and primary/secondary endpoint definitions
Sample size calculation assumptions (alpha, beta/power, expected effect size, dropout rate)
Interim analysis schedule and formal stopping boundaries (e.g. O'Brien-Fleming)
Handling of protocol deviations, missing data, and crossover
Complete Bibliographic Citation
negative_constraints: NO extraction of fictitious efficacy results for uncompleted protocol papers
NO medical disclaimers

FW_F.name: Non-Inferiority & Equivalence RCT
mandatory_elements: Pre-specified non-inferiority margin (Delta) and historical justification vs active comparator
Mandatory dual reporting and divergence analysis between Per-Protocol (PP) and Intention-to-Treat (ITT) populations
Comparison of upper 95% Confidence Interval against the Delta margin
Audit of biocreep and potential loss of active comparator efficacy retention
Complete Bibliographic Citation
negative_constraints: NO acceptance of non-inferiority claims based exclusively on ITT population
NO omitted Delta margin definitions
NO medical disclaimers

FW_G.name: Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR)
mandatory_elements: Economic model structure (Markov state-transition, decision tree, discrete event simulation)
Time horizon, cycle length, and perspective (societal vs health system/payer)
Annual discount rate applied to costs and health outcomes (typically 3-5%)
ICER per QALY/DALY gained compared to established Willingness-to-Pay thresholds
Deterministic and Probabilistic Sensitivity Analysis (PSA / Cost-Effectiveness Acceptability Curve)
Complete Bibliographic Citation
negative_constraints: NO cost-effectiveness claims without explicit discount rate and time horizon disclosure
NO medical disclaimers

FW_H.name: Narrative Review & Clinical Update
mandatory_elements: Scope of review and clinical questions addressed
SANRA 6-domain critical score assessment (Importance, Aims, Search, Referencing, Reasoning, Data presentation)
Critique of non-systematic search vulnerabilities and potential selection/cherry-picking bias
Assessment of author conflicts of interest and funding transparency
Complete Bibliographic Citation
negative_constraints: NO presentation of narrative review claims as Level 1 clinical evidence
NO missing conflict of interest evaluation
NO medical disclaimers
